Instructions

In this study you will read 1 short scenario. You will be asked to rate some statements about the scenario and people involved. The scenario and the corresponding questions will appear on multiple pages, but the previous information about the story will always be repeated and shown at the top of all pages.

In some of the questions, you will be asked to report a single value on a slider to indicate the answer you think is most likely. For example, if you think 2 is more likely than any other number on the scale, slide the slider knob to the number 2. However, if you really think there is not a single value that is more likely than others, you can choose the option “I don’t know. All values are equally likely”. If you choose this option, you don’t need to move the slider knob to choose a value.
